items.briefing:
The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has issued a warning about critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler products — if your organisation uses these, IT teams should apply patches urgently. Separately, a new scam is targeting large organisations by impersonating merger and acquisition activity to trick staff into transferring funds or sharing sensitive information. Businesses should also be aware that many organisations lack proper backup protections, leaving them exposed if ransomware strikes.

Australia's privacy law reforms are progressing, so now is a good time to review how your organisation handles personal data before new requirements take effect. **Practical tip:** If you receive unexpected emails about company mergers or acquisitions requesting urgent action, verify through a known internal contact before responding.
